opening.speaker: NARRATOR
opening.title: CHAPTER ONE · NO BOARD, NO ENTRY
opening.text: The Grand Battle Chess registration hall is louder than the arenas outside. Every Boardmaster in line has a crest, a sponsor, and fighters waiting behind them. You have an application.

opening.speaker: REGISTRATION CLERK
opening.title: GRAND TOURNAMENT INTAKE
opening.text: Board name? Registered King? Licensed roster? ...None of them? Then there is nothing for me to enter. Bronze circuit takes eight fighters. Come back when you have a board.

opening.speaker: GORO
opening.title: OUTSIDE THE HALL
opening.text: Don't chase sixteen names before you can command eight. Bronze Board is enough to get through the first gate. I know five people willing to stand with you. The last three have to be your choices.

opening.speaker: MIRA
opening.title: THE OLD TRAINING YARD
opening.text: We scout first. Not for the biggest number—for the missing shape. Queen, Rook, Pawn. Then train them where the board actually needs them.

opening.speaker: YOU
opening.title: FIRST OBJECTIVE
opening.text: Eight positions. One qualifier. Build the board, earn the licence, and make them remember the name they refused to register.

victory.speaker: NARRATOR
victory.title: THE FIRST STAMP
victory.text: The local arena goes quiet before the result board changes. Then the Bronze seal appears beside your name.

victory.speaker: GORO
victory.title: AFTER THE QUALIFIER
victory.text: Now you're registered. That is not the same thing as being ready. From here, every board has a history—and every fighter you put on yours starts writing one.

victory.speaker: MIRA
victory.title: NEXT CIRCUIT
victory.text: The city league opens next. Full scouting reports, rival Boardmasters, contracts, injuries that last, and enough attention that people will start trying to take our fighters from us.

victory.speaker: NARRATOR
victory.title: DEMO COMPLETE
victory.text: Chapter One complete. Your roster, relationships, training choices, injuries, and result remain in the save. The next build continues from this board.
